_comment: AUDITION SET B recast briefs. Only the 3 roles Owner rejected in Set A are recast here; the 5 approved roles in casting_candidates.json are locked and must never be touched by --audition-set-b. Candidates are discovered live from the ElevenLabs Voice Library (GET /v1/shared-voices) on the Owner's machine -- this account's personal 27-voice pool (from Set A) is fully exhausted for these 3 roles, so no voice_id is hardcoded here. Each matched Voice Library voice is added to the account (POST /v1/voices/add/{public_owner_id}/{voice_id}) to get a usable local voice_id, then used for TTS with the same canonical sample line as its role/locale in casting_candidates.json audition_sample_lines.
exclude_voice_ids_comment: Every voice_id already surfaced in AUDITION SET A (locked approvals + explicitly rejected candidates), so Set B never re-offers or double-casts an already-decided voice.

zh_elder.character_brief: Male preferred; older adult / elder; calm; wise; warm; natural; grounded; believable village elder. Not commercial-announcer-like. Not exaggerated fantasy wizard. Taiwan Mandarin preferred where available.

zh_hero.character_brief: CRITICAL CANON: the Hero is a MALE character (young male protagonist). Young, approximately late-teen/young-adult; natural; sincere; gentle but adventurous. Not childish. Not deep middle-aged male. Not broadcaster. Not overly heroic/anime exaggerated. Taiwan Mandarin strongly preferred.

en_hero.character_brief: Male; clearly younger than the rejected Will/Charlie; late-teen/young-adult impression; natural; approachable; sincere; slightly adventurous; capable of vulnerability. Not a deep/mature narrator voice. Not a booming hero voice. Not a commercial announcer.
